transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Yeah… I came in because I can’t get this thought to stop. Like, even when I’ve already done my safety check on the cab — and I know I did it, I can remember doing it — this thought just keeps coming back that maybe I missed something. Like maybe there’s something wrong with the car and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied about checking it properly.

And it’s not just a quick worry, it kind of hits me over and over while I’m driving, and then I’m trying to focus on the road but it’s still there in my head. Even when I’m trying to study, it comes back, like I can’t shut it off. It’s gotten really hard to deal with.

When you have these thoughts, do you find yourself doing certain things over and over — like checking things again, repeating actions, or trying to neutralize the thought with another thought — to try to make the anxiety go away?

Yeah… I do. That’s kind of the main thing, I think. Before I can take a ride, I keep checking the cab again and again. Like I’ll go around the car and check the tires, then the lights, then the doors, then the meter, then the paperwork… and I’ll tell myself, okay, that’s done, I checked it. But then as soon as I’m about to start, it’s like, wait, did I really check the back tire properly? Did I actually see the light working or did I just think I saw it?

So I go back around and do it again. And sometimes I take pictures on my phone, like of the tires or the meter or whatever, so I can prove to myself I checked. But even then I’ll look at the picture and think maybe it doesn’t show the right angle, or maybe I took it before I really checked properly. And if the whole check doesn’t feel right, like if I got distracted or did it in the wrong order, I’ll restart the whole thing from the beginning.

It gets really bad when passengers are waiting, because I know I’m making them wait and I’m already late, but I still feel like I can’t just drive off. I’ll be standing there checking the same door or walking around the car again, and I know it probably looks ridiculous, but in the moment it feels like if I don’t do it, something bad could happen or I’ll be blamed for not checking properly.
